ITEM.PTXT: The display screens of the HDD navigation system consist of the TV mode screen, information mode screen, navigation mode screen, etc., and each mode screen can be called up using the panel switches located around the multi-display.

After each mode screen (TV, information, etc.) is called up, operations are performed with touch switches, which allow input by directly touching the switch frames displayed on the display screen with a finger.
TV/audio volume adjustment, etc. can be performed with the steering switches located on the steering wheel.

By pressing the talk switch to display the voice recognition mark on the screen and then speaking a voice command toward the voice recognition microphone, navigation and other operations can be performed, providing excellent operability.
Voice operation has a "Standard Mode" and an "Extended Mode", which can be switched as desired according to purpose.
Basic voice commands for navigation and G-BOOK ALPHA operation can be used
The command list is displayed by pressing the talk switch or pressing the "Help" touch switch
Navigation, audio and G-BOOK ALPHA can be operated
All voice commands can be used
The command list is displayed by touching the "Help" touch switch
Map search is also possible by speaking a genre, telephone number, postal code, map code or memory point name
G-BOOK ALPHA voice commands are valid only when a service contract and various registrations have been completed.
